skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic agricultural technologies in crop cultivation, protection, and harvesting.
Analyze and evaluate crop cultivation technologies.
Analyze and evaluate crop protection technologies.
Analyze and evaluate crop harvesting technologies.
Conduct research, analyze, and synthesize to select appropriate technologies for practical application in agriculture.
Develop logical and evidence-based arguments in analyzing and selecting agricultural technologies.
Self-study and research to complete assigned tasks.
Draw conclusions on issues related to the selection and application of agricultural technologies.
Prepare and deliver presentations on agricultural technologies.
Work effectively in groups to research, analyze, and present on agricultural technologies.
